question: A rectangular coordinate plane is formed by the intersection of the:
urdu_translation: rectangular coordinate plane کن lines کے intersection سے بنتا ہے؟

C: One axis and one curve / one axis اور one curve
D: x-axis and y-axis / x-axis اور y-axis
correct_answer: D | x-axis and y-axis / x-axis اور y-axis

question: A vector quantity has:
urdu_translation: vector quantity میں کیا ہوتا ہے؟
A: Both magnitude and direction / magnitude اور direction دونوں
D: Neither magnitude nor direction / نہ magnitude نہ direction
correct_answer: A | Both magnitude and direction / magnitude اور direction دونوں

urdu_translation: two vectors equal کب ہوتے ہیں؟

C: Terminal point only / صرف terminal point
